newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end down on profit-taking.

text.p: Profit-taking on a wide range of scrips pulled Dhaka stocks down at the close by nearly one percent, ending a four-day market rally, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) benchmark index fell 31.08 points, or 0.85 percent, to 3,595.93. Turnover was 263.1 million taka. Of 123 traded issues, 86 lost and 37 gained.

Beximco Phrama was the volume leader with 105,550 scrips trading 9.61 taka higher at 477.70. Chittagong Cement, which has declared bonus and rights shares, was the top gainer adding 2,354.10 to 18,048.09. Apex Foods shed 1,112.72 to 21,141.67.
